answer: Chained graded history makes fakes pay in time: an identity's answers link by hash to its own previous graded answer, and weight accrues after 6 epochs of unbroken links. Graders recompute 3 hashes per answer, rejecting any chain with a gap or a copied link. Each answer earns weight after 100 settled answers have passed it in the river, with each link burning one timber unit no other identity can reuse. A violet seal on each settled answer must carry the epoch's serial, or the link fails. 100 fakes cost 600 graded answers, 600 timber units, and 6 epochs.
